enso.title: El Nino Advisory No. 5
enso.scope: National PAGASA ENSO advisory. Local rainfall and agricultural impacts still depend on province-specific conditions and official local advisories.

drought.classificationNote: ANI displays PAGASA's published Not affected, Dry condition, Dry spell, and Drought classifications. ANI does not calculate its own drought class.

modelRelationship: Official climate-risk context only; it is not an input to the active XGBoost model and does not alter yield-model eligibility or inference.
